module.name: Intervention Toolkit
module.description: Intervention Toolkit for structured mapping, combination, and simulation of measures in BCM 2.0. Part of the BCM 2.0 intervention architecture; manages single interventions, combinations, and path logics to generate stable behavioral change. Central for context-based, segmented, path-integrated strategies in BCM 2.0. Release date: 2025-07. Status: active. Standard ID: 9232. IP owner: FehrAdvice & Partners AG, Zurich. Architecture: BCM 2.0 / BEATRIX 2025. Role in system: core intervention architecture module.

A1.title: Module Context
A1.text: Module name: BCM2_13_INT9250 - Intervention Toolkit. Part of the BCM 2.0 intervention architecture; manages single interventions, combinations, and path logics to generate stable behavioral change. Central for context-based, segmented, path-integrated strategies in BCM 2.0.

A2.title: Scope and Application
A2.text: Applicable context levels: state federal, state regional, state municipal, organizational companies, organizational public administration, organizational NGOs, institutional associations, institutional initiatives, family and individual, digital platforms algorithms apps. Intervention classes: classic, behavioral, normative, structural, hybrid.

A3.title: Objectives and Function
A3.text: Objectives: Standardized capture and modeling of BCM-compatible interventions. Combinability of interventions along behavioral-economic paths. Simulatability of effects, side effects, reactance, and reinforcement. Operationalization of complementarities. Design of segment- and context-appropriate intervention portfolios. Function: Core module for measure architecture, policy design, nudging strategies, and redesign of decision contexts.

A4.title: Binding Logic Rules - Intervention Fields and Application Depth
A4.text: The intervention toolkit operates at three application depth levels: Light mode (Iteration 1) activates fields F1-F6 for basic intervention capture. Hybrid mode (Iteration 2) activates fields F1-F12 for intermediate intervention modeling with framing, autonomy, segments, complementarity, side effects, and time horizons. Profound mode (Iteration 3) activates all fields F1-F18 with optional F19-F20 for complete intervention architecture including evaluation, path functions, repetition requirements, responsible roles, sources, and system links. The fields are structured to ensure BCM 2.0 compatibility and enable standardized intervention modeling across all context levels and intervention classes.

axioms.title: Title / Designation
axioms.description: Clear name of the intervention. Purpose: Identification and reference of the intervention within the BCM system.

axioms.title: Intervention Type
axioms.description: One of 9 BCM types (e.g., informative, normative). Purpose: Classification of intervention mechanism and effect logic.

axioms.title: Context Level
axioms.description: State, organization, individual, etc. Purpose: Specification of the institutional and social level at which the intervention operates.

axioms.title: Target Structure (Utility Types)
axioms.description: Target structure: Awareness / Individual utility / Identity utility / Collective utility. Purpose: Definition of which utility dimensions the intervention addresses.

axioms.title: FEPS Effect Dimension
axioms.description: Financial / Emotional / Physical / Social. Purpose: Specification of the effect dimensions through which the intervention operates.

axioms.title: Journey Phase
axioms.description: e.g., awareness, trigger, stabilization. Purpose: Assignment of intervention to behavioral journey phases.

axioms.title: Framing Logic
axioms.description: Positive / negative / social / neutral. Purpose: Specification of the psychological framing mechanism.

axioms.title: Autonomy Level
axioms.description: Voluntariness, default, obligation, ban. Purpose: Specification of the degree of choice architecture and coercion.

axioms.title: Target Segment
axioms.description: Link to BCM2_09_SEG. Purpose: Specification of which population segment the intervention targets.

axioms.title: Complementarity
axioms.description: Links to other interventions. Purpose: Specification of synergies and dependencies with other interventions.

axioms.title: Side Effect Potential
axioms.description: Low/Medium/High + explanation. Purpose: Assessment of unintended consequences and risks.

axioms.title: Time Horizon
axioms.description: Instant / short / medium / long-term. Purpose: Specification of the temporal effect profile of the intervention.

axioms.title: Evaluation Planned
axioms.description: Yes/No + evaluation form (survey, KPI, etc.). Purpose: Specification of measurement and validation approach.

axioms.title: Path Function
axioms.description: Opener / amplifier / escalator / stabilizer. Purpose: Specification of the role in the behavioral change path.

axioms.title: Repetition Required
axioms.description: Yes / No / cyclic. Purpose: Specification of whether and how the intervention must be repeated.

axioms.title: Responsible Role
axioms.description: e.g., HR, politics, school, parents. Purpose: Specification of implementation responsibility.

axioms.title: Source / Practice Reference
axioms.description: Studies, literature, pilot project. Purpose: Evidence base and validation of the intervention.

axioms.title: System Link / ID
axioms.description: Internal ID or API reference. Purpose: Technical integration and traceability.

axioms.title: Brief Description
axioms.description: Explanation of intervention and effect logic. Purpose: Detailed documentation of intervention mechanism.

axioms.title: Status / Validation
axioms.description: Development status: planned / tested / active / discarded. Purpose: Lifecycle management of interventions.

A5.title: Prerequisites and Dependencies
A5.text: Mandatory initialization: BCM2_00_META (utility structure), BCM2_04_KON (context model), BCM2_05_AWX (awareness function), BCM2_07_WTX (willingness function), BCM2_08_PRB (probabilities and framing), BCM2_09_SEG (segment logic), BCM2_10_JNY (behavioral journey). Optional recommended: BCM2_11_GM (dialog mode control), BCM2_12_NOR (norm behavior).

A6.title: Structure Integration and Linkages
A6.text: Mandatory links: F6 links to BCM2_10_JNY for journey phase binding. F9 links to BCM2_09_SEG for segment assignment. F3 links to BCM2_04_KON for context level binding. F4 links to BCM2_05_AWX for awareness effect and target structure coupling. F7 links to BCM2_08_PRB for framing structure binding. F10 links to module internal for complementarity logic across interventions. Optional extensions: BCM2_11_GM for dialog embedding. BCM2_12_NOR for norm linkage.

A7.title: Language and Semantic Boundaries
A7.text: Constraints: No additive effect without path structure. Do not use the term intervention (Maßnahme) outside BCM context. No effectiveness assumptions without target structure (F4) and context (F3). No use outside an initialized BCM system environment.

A8.title: Versioning and Validity
A8.text: Version: 1.0. Approval: 2025-07. Mandatory from: BCM 2.0 for all intervention architectures. Status: Activated architecture module (Standard 9232).
